maddeler.e:
نستعطر (form X)
# نَسْتَعْطِرُ (nastaʕṭiru) /nas.taʕ.tˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# نَسْتَعْطِرَ (nastaʕṭira) /nas.taʕ.tˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# نَسْتَعْطِرْ (nastaʕṭir) /nas.taʕ.tˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
